title: Hearty Basque Cheese Stew
description: A briny, gooey Basque-inspired stew perfect for post-workout recovery, featuring a blend of fresh vegetables, a deglazing splash of wine, and rich Manchego cheese.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add diced onion and cook until translucent, about five minutes.
Stir in minced garlic and cook for thirty seconds until fragrant.
Add diced red bell pepper and zucchini, cooking until softened, about five minutes.
Pour in white wine, scraping up any browned bits, and reduce by half, about three minutes.
Stir in canned diced tomatoes, all-purpose seasoning, and salt, then bring to a simmer.
Pour in vegetable broth, cover, and let the mixture simmer gently for ten minutes.
Remove the lid, stir in milk, and continue to simmer until the stew thickens slightly, about five minutes.
Reduce heat to low, sprinkle grated Manchego cheese over the stew, and let melt until gooey, about three minutes.
Adjust seasoning with salt if needed, then serve hot over roasted potatoes or crusty bread.
